hypothesis: With identical Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M weights, Q4 KV retains enough long-context information to answer six individual factual questions almost as accurately as Q8 KV while using about half as much KV memory.

supersedes.reason: The three-answer JSON task produced a floor effect in both lanes. This version asks one short factual question at a time and removes structured-output skill from the measurement.

input.source: The same two private cleaned Codex conversations and six questions used by Gate 16B.1

evaluation.quality: One manually audited factual point per answer; maximum 6 points per lane.
evaluation.q4_quality_success: Q4 KV loses no more than one point versus Q8 KV and produces no degenerate answer.
evaluation.speed: Report first-question prefill, cached follow-up latency, prompt tokens per second, and generated tokens per second.
evaluation.memory: Report the runtime KV buffer at num_ctx=16384 and one slot.
